rules: L1: linear, linear_no_bias and causal_gqa_attention are vendor primitives (GEMM, SDPA); their cases are not searched (vendor).

L1: per (model, task) the searched configuration is the one with the largest eager time share per step, forward+backward ms per call (l1_timing.json, GH200, order 303) x calls per step; a single-configuration task searches its one case. The others: not_time_max_config. A configuration's timing is the l1_timing.json row of its task, dims and dtype (its case id breaks a tie between layouts); a row under another case id stands for it only when that id is no longer observed (a renamed case).

L1: a time-max configuration identical to another model's (same task, dims, dtype, layout, strides and free sizes) is searched once, in the model that calls it most per step; the others are identical_config_of that case (of = model:case_id) and are evaluated with its submission on their own payloads.

L2: a megafold_evoattention configuration inside triangle attention (module paths containing tri_attn) whose containing triangle_attention case is searched is nested_in it (L2-3: the two searches would install one inside the other; of = that case's id, the note names any other searched container); one whose containers are not searched is a configuration of the task like the others.

L2: per (model, task) the searched configuration is the one with the largest eager time per step, forward+backward wall ms per call x calls per step (l2_share/report.json), among the configurations not nested_in a searched case; the others: not_time_max_config.

L2: a searched configuration's optimizable share of the eager step (L2-5: non-library kernel ms, or wall minus library ms where the step is not CUDA-graph captured, x calls / eager step ms; l2_share/report.json) must be at least 1%; below it: optimizable_share_below_1pct.

L2 exceptions, searched whatever their share (reason null, note says why): every swiglu MLP (qwen3_swiglu_mlp, llama3_swiglu_mlp, qwen3_5_swiglu_mlp, qwen2_vl_2b_text_mlp) as the shape-generalisation ablation group; torchrec_dlrm_dlrm_interaction, which keeps DLRM an L2/L3 case (2026-11-10).
Benchmark rows, the evaluation's denominators: the searched cases plus the identical_config_of cases.
notes: MegaFold AdaLN (megafold_adaptive_layernorm in l2_share/report.json) is not a task: deferred 2026-11-10.

report.json measured the merged attention blocks as the sum of the two tasks each replaces (rows attention_block, gated_attention_block) and the tasks added since as synthetic blocks; MEASURED_AS in write_search_set.py maps them by meaning to the task names, a configuration to a row by its dims.

An L2 share is report.json's per-call optimizable time x this configuration's calls per step / the eager step. report.json's row must have measured these calls and (a corpus row, or the corpus rows a merged row sums) these dims and dtype; only RESCALED in write_search_set.py may differ in calls (olmoe and qwen3_5 residual_rmsnorm, 16->32 and 32->64; the tasks measured as synthetic blocks).
No gate settings and no corpus paths: the gates read the model integrations, a task pack binds its corpus.
